_comment: ILS per runway end of provpilot/airports.json, built by scripts/build_world_ils.py. Real localizers / glide slopes / ILS DMEs from FlightGear nav.dat (GPL-2, cycle 2013.10); runtime geometry comes from the catalog runway (NavaidsLib) unless `offset` is true, when the nav.dat localizer course and position are used. `source` is 'nav.dat' or 'synthetic' (paved runway >= 1500 m without real ILS, invented frequency and ident). freq_khz: 110500 = 110.50 MHz. Entries with `updated` carry a correction from scripts/ils_updates.json (frequency / ident changes since 2013, from the AIPs).
